name: Private keys
source: export default (text: string): string => text.replace(/-----BEGIN (?:[A-Z0-9]+ )*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----[\s\S]+?-----END (?:[A-Z0-9]+ )*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----/g, "[REDACTED_PRIVATE_KEY]");

name: API keys
description: Redacts recognized API key and Alook credential formats.

name: Tokens
description: Redacts JWTs and Authorization bearer/basic values.
source: export default (text: string): string => text.replace(/(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])/g, "[REDACTED_TOKEN]").replace(/(\b(?:Authorization\s*:\s*)?(?:Bearer|Basic)\s+)[A-Za-z0-9._~+\/-]+={0,2}/gi, (all, prefix) => /Authorization/i.test(prefix) || all.length-prefix.length >= 8 ? prefix+"[REDACTED_TOKEN]" : all);

name: Passwords and secrets
description: Redacts credential assignments and passwords in connection URLs.
source: export default (text: string): string => text.replace(/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/[^\s:@/?#"'<>]*:)([^\s@/?#"'<>]{3,})(@)/g, "$1[REDACTED_PASSWORD]$3").replace(/(\b[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*(?:password|passwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key|access[_-]?key|credential)[A-Za-z0-9_.-]*["']?\s*[:=]\s*["']?)([A-Za-z0-9_\-./+=~!@#%^&*]{8,})/gi, (all, prefix, value) => { const field = prefix.replace(/["'\s:=]+$/g, ""); return /(?:id|ids|uuid|guid|hash|digest|checksum|cursor)$/i.test(field) || /^(?:process\.env|os\.)/.test(value) || !/[A-Za-z]/.test(value) || !/\d/.test(value) ? all : prefix + "[REDACTED_SECRET]"; });
